faq.q: What boats are available for a Marbella Pride boat party?
faq.a: We have 15+ boats departing from Puerto Banús. For Pride parties, popular choices include the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) from €749/2h. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for 4 hours includes a free jet ski. All charters include skipper, drinks and snacks.

faq.q: How much does a Pride yacht party cost in Marbella?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours and €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks and 21% VAT. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, also all-inclusive. For other vessels, request a quote via WhatsApp.

faq.q: What's included in the Pride boat party price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, and safety equipment. Spanish IVA (21%) is always included. There are no hidden costs – just bring your Pride spirit and swimwear.

faq.q: Can we bring our own music and decorations?
faq.a: Yes, all our boats have Bluetooth speakers, so you can play your Pride playlist. You're welcome to bring decorations, but please check with us first – some boats have restrictions on confetti or heavy items. We'll advise on what's allowed to keep the boat safe.

faq.q: How many people can join a Pride boat party?
faq.a: Capacity varies by boat: the Dubhe and Mariah SX21 take 5 guests, the Bandido and Red Tide take 6–8, the Astondoa 40 takes 9, and the Azimut 39, Fairline Targa, Lagoon 380, Pershing 46 and all 24m+ yachts take 10–12. Choose based on your group size.

faq.q: Where do Pride boat parties depart from?
faq.a: All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, the glamorous marina in Marbella. You'll meet the crew at the designated dock (we'll send exact location after booking). From there, you can cruise along the coast towards Cabopino or Estepona, or anchor at Cala del Faro for a swim.

faq.q: Can we book a Pride boat party for a specific time?
faq.a: Yes, we offer flexible departure times. Most parties choose a 2-hour sunset cruise (e.g., 18:00–20:00) or a longer 4–8 hour day charter. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum is 4 hours. For other boats, contact us via WhatsApp to arrange your preferred slot.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad on Pride day?
faq.a: If the captain deems conditions unsafe, we'll reschedule your charter for another day or offer a full refund. We monitor forecasts closely and will notify you at least 24 hours in advance if a cancellation is likely. In case of sudden storms, we'll return to port early.

data.body_html:
Marbella Pride 2051 is set to be the biggest LGBTQ+ celebration on the Costa del Sol, and there's no better way to join the party than from the deck of a private yacht. Departing from Puerto Banús, our boats let you soak up the sun, dance to your own playlist, and cruise the glittering Mediterranean with your chosen crew. Whether you're after a 2-hour sunset sail or a full-day flotilla, we've got the vessel and the all-inclusive package to make it unforgettable.

Why Choose a Yacht for Marbella Pride?

Pride is about visibility, joy, and community – and a boat party delivers all three. You'll avoid the crowded beach clubs, control your own music, and have the freedom to anchor at hidden coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. With a licensed skipper handling navigation, you can focus on celebrating. Plus, every charter includes drinks and snacks, so no queuing at bars.

Our Pride-Ready Fleet from Puerto Banús

We operate 15+ boats from Puerto Banús, each with different capacities and vibes. For intimate groups of 5–8, the Dubhe (8m) or Bandido (11.5m) are perfect. For up to 11 guests, the Azimut 39 (12.5m) offers sleek sport-cruiser energy. Larger parties of 12 can opt for the Mangusta 80 (24m) or the Ferretti 94 (29m) – both with spacious sundecks and flybridges.

What's Included in Your Pride Charter

  • Licensed skipper (English/Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine and cava
  • Light snacks (chips, olives, sandwiches)
  • Insurance and safety equipment (life jackets, flares)
  • Spanish IVA (21%) – always included

You're welcome to bring your own food and drinks (no glass, please) and a Bluetooth speaker for your Pride playlist.

Itinerary Ideas for Your Pride Party

Most parties cruise south from Puerto Banús towards Cabopino or north to Estepona. A popular route is to anchor at Cala del Faro for a swim, then cruise along the Golden Mile with views of La Concha mountain. For a longer charter (4–8 hours), head to Sotogrande or the dunes of Cabopino. Your skipper can tailor the route to your wishes.

Booking Your Pride Boat Party

To secure your date, contact us via our homepage or WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance, as Pride week fills up fast. A 50% deposit holds your boat; the balance is due on the day. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online – see Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 pages for availability.

Pride 2051: Dates and Events

Marbella Pride 2051 typically takes place in late June, with the main parade along the Golden Mile and parties at Puerto Banús. Check the official Pride calendar for exact dates. Our boats are available throughout the week, so you can celebrate before, during, or after the main events. For a full-day flotilla, consider the Mangusta 80 – it includes a free jet ski for extra thrills.
